features.title: Link and watch GitHub pull requests from DSH threads
features.summary: Durably links GitHub.com pull requests to threads, polls each watched repository and number every two minutes through gh, queues concise state transitions, and asks thread-sidebar to settle merged or closed threads.
features.currentSurface: agent tools and Host watcher; no UI
failureModes: If gh is missing, unauthenticated, or returns an invalid response, the watcher keeps its last known state and records a bounded error code; a later poll retries.
GitHub rate limits increase a persisted per-PR delay exponentially from two minutes up to one hour.
If thread-sidebar is not loaded, the state still updates and the Host logs that notification or settlement was skipped.

externalDependencies.boundary: Runs gh repo view for number-plus-cwd links and gh pr view with state, mergeable, mergeStateStatus, reviewDecision, statusCheckRollup, comments and reviews; uses the CLI's configured login without reading or storing credentials. GitHub.com only.
externalDependencies.deterministicFake: tests/pull-request-model.spec.ts supplies fixed CLI-shaped JSON to the production Effect Schema decoder; tests/host.spec.ts uses a real test Host without invoking GitHub.

features.title: Create a GitHub pull request from a thread
features.summary: Previews the thread's jj workspace (repository, base, bookmark, commits above the base, an open pull request for the bookmark) with a title and body drafted from the thread by its model, then on explicit confirm sets the bookmark, pushes it with jj git push, runs gh pr create and links and watches the pull request on the thread.
failureModes: gh missing, not signed in, or no GitHub repository for the workspace blocks the preview with an install, `gh auth login` or remote recovery.
jj missing, not a jj workspace, no remote, an unknown base branch, no commits, undescribed or conflicted commits block the preview with the exact jj command to fix it.
A workspace whose head moved since the preview is refused before anything is written; the user previews again.
A rejected push explains fetch-and-rebase or credential recovery; a gh pr create failure after the push says the branch is pushed and how to link the PR by hand.
No model route or no model answer falls back to a title and body drafted from the commit messages and says why.

externalDependencies.boundary: Runs gh auth status --hostname github.com, gh repo view --json nameWithOwner,defaultBranchRef, gh pr list --head, and gh pr create --repo --head --base --title --body [--draft] with the CLI's configured login; never reads or stores a token.
externalDependencies.deterministicFake: tests/create.spec.ts replaces the GitHubCli service with scripted results; tests/create-host.spec.ts puts a shell-script gh on PATH that answers the same calls and logs every argv.

externalDependencies.boundary: Fixed-argv jj through @dshfiles/jj-cli: git remote list, log over <base>@<remote>..head, bookmark set on the previewed commit, git push --remote --bookmark.
externalDependencies.deterministicFake: tests/create.spec.ts replaces the Jj service with a scripted runner; tests/create-host.spec.ts uses real jj against a temporary bare Git remote.

externalDependencies.boundary: One dshx Llm completion on the thread's last request route (or a passed provider/model) with the thread title, a bounded transcript and the commit list.
